name: ATLAS-W Gunner Station — First and Third Person
scope: Additive atlas_w_operator only. Original sailing host, fleet model/dynamics, mobile modules, projectile/effect modules and original HUMANS implementation are unchanged.

operator.license: MIT; exact license/source/provenance retained beside asset
operator.representation: Textured animated 3D character, not a live connected player or likeness of the user
operator.station: New fictional open training console on the turret roof; not Bay station acceptance

features: Visible articulated gunner with hands on controls and feet on authored supports
Third-person view starts over the shoulder and follows the turret
First person uses the posed head location and hides head/hair only
Look-down view shows the actual hands and console; focus/zoom option
Breathing and small firing reactions use the same simulation time
WASD/arrows driving and Space/Fire remain available in both views
Mouse drag aims and short left click fires in first/third-person views
Mobile view buttons coexist with left driving pad and right Fire control
Asset failure disables unavailable character views rather than inventing a fallback person
Existing game projectiles, explosions, target scoring and pause behavior retained

controls.V: Look at hands and console / return to sight
controls.Space_Fire: Fire salvo; hold to repeat after cooldown
controls.MouseDrag: Manual traverse and elevation in gunner views

tests.scope: Local Node execution using actual Three scene/skeleton/skin geometry and exact GLB, with synthetic DOM/events and a test-only texture decoder bypass. No browser or GPU.

numericChecks.qualification: Joint and selected-foot/projection checks only; not complete full-body clearance, native UI or visual acceptance.

publicReceipt: Ordinary web-reader access to this exact URL was unavailable. Source publication is confirmed; no public HTTP/render/touch success is claimed.
limits: No new browser, CI or workflow execution; earlier blocked automation was not retried or routed elsewhere
No rendered texture/shader, physical-phone, Safari, audio, FPS or optical-latency verification
No walk-around character, boarding animation, full-body collision/ergonomic certification or multiplayer
No H4/H5/H7, CORE station, human occupancy or fit approval transfer
Not a photorealistic human or military uniform claim; original licensed character texture retained
Original ship/water/terrain and physics coefficients unchanged; fictional game mechanics
Existing slow-render interruption pause remains and may require Resume
